name: Therefore, In Short, Then
effect: Sentences are swamped by discourse connectives ('however', 'therefore', 'in short', 'so then', 'consequently') and never reach a point. Answers often fall into loops of 'so then, so then', and at times it seems to know it is lost.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
